def clean_text(v):
    if v is None:
        return ""
    return str(v).replace("\xa0", " ").strip()

def split_excel_concat(expr):
    """Split an Excel concatenation expression on & outside quoted strings."""
    parts, cur, in_quote = [], "", False
    i = 0
    while i < len(expr):
        ch = expr[i]
        if ch == '"':
            cur += ch
            # Excel escaped quote inside string is ""
            if in_quote and i + 1 < len(expr) and expr[i + 1] == '"':
                cur += expr[i + 1]
                i += 2
                continue
            in_quote = not in_quote
        elif ch == "&" and not in_quote:
            parts.append(cur.strip())
            cur = ""
        else:
            cur += ch
        i += 1
    parts.append(cur.strip())
    return parts

def get_cell_value(wb, ws, token, seen=None):

        sheet_name = m.group(1) or m.group(2) or ws.title

    key = «redacted» col.upper(), row)
    if key in seen:

    return eval_excel_value(wb, ref_ws, val, seen)

def eval_excel_value(wb, ws, value, seen=None):
    """Evaluate simple IF and & formulas present in the file; return displayed literal value."""
    if seen is None:
        seen = set()

    if value is None:
        return ""
    if not isinstance(value, str):
        return value

    s = value.strip()
    if not s.startswith("="):
        return s.replace("\xa0", " ").strip()

    expr = s[1:].strip()

    # Handle formulas like IF(C2="","",E2&" - "&B2)
    if expr.upper().startswith("IF(") and expr.endswith(")"):
        inner = expr[3:-1]
        args, cur, in_quote, depth = [], "", False, 0
        i = 0
        while i < len(inner):
            ch = inner[i]
            if ch == '"':
                cur += ch
                if in_quote and i + 1 < len(inner) and inner[i + 1] == '"':
                    cur += inner[i + 1]
                    i += 2
                    continue
                in_quote = not in_quote
            elif ch == "(" and not in_quote:
                depth += 1
                cur += ch
            elif ch == ")" and not in_quote:
                depth -= 1
                cur += ch
            elif ch == "," and not in_quote and depth == 0:
                args.append(cur.strip())
                cur = ""
            else:
                cur += ch
            i += 1
        args.append(cur.strip())

        if len(args) >= 3:
            cond = args[0].strip()
            # This workbook uses tests of the form Ref=""
            cond_match = re.match(r'(.+?)\s*=\s*""$', cond)
            condition_true = False
            if cond_match:
                left_val = get_cell_value(wb, ws, cond_match.group(1).strip(), seen.copy())
                condition_true = (clean_text(left_val) == "")
            chosen = args[1] if condition_true else args[2]
            return eval_excel_value(wb, ws, "=" + chosen, seen.copy())

    # Handle concatenation with &
    if "&" in expr:
        out = ""
        for part in split_excel_concat(expr):
            part = part.strip()
            if len(part) >= 2 and part[0] == '"' and part[-1] == '"':
                out += part[1:-1].replace('""', '"')
            elif re.fullmatch(r"-?\d+(?:\.\d+)?", part):
                # Excel concatenates numerics without trailing .0 for integers
                num = float(part)
                out += str(int(num)) if num.is_integer() else str(num)
            else:
                out += clean_text(get_cell_value(wb, ws, part, seen.copy()))
        return out.replace("\xa0", " ").strip()

    # Handle bare quoted string, numeric, or cell reference
    if len(expr) >= 2 and expr[0] == '"' and expr[-1] == '"':
        return expr[1:-1].replace('""', '"')
    if re.fullmatch(r"-?\d+(?:\.\d+)?", expr):
        num = float(expr)
        return int(num) if num.is_integer() else num
    return clean_text(get_cell_value(wb, ws, expr, seen.copy()))

def extract_name_from_column_i(display_value):
    """
    Column I contains strings such as:
      1 - Tbnor, Cadigan - TA32785655
      Tbra, Cadle - AA21259159
    The desired outcome is only the text/name portion.
    """
    s = clean_text(display_value)
    if not s:
        return None

    parts = [clean_text(p) for p in s.split(" - ")]
    if len(parts) == 1:
        return parts[0] or None

    # Remove optional leading numeric marker like "1" or "2".
    start = 1 if re.fullmatch(r"\d+(?:\.\d+)?", parts[0]) else 0

    # Remove trailing ID/code/value segment.
    middle = parts[start:-1]
    result = " - ".join(p for p in middle if p != "").strip()
    return result or None

            return result if result != "" else None
        # Fallback if the string is simply "Text - ID".

        return None

        return None

        start = 1 if re.fullmatch(r"\d+(?:\.\d+)?", parts[0]) else 0

        middle = parts[start:-1]
